question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is Option (4) i.e. **'However'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**However**" is used to introduce a statement that contrasts with or seems to contradict something that has been said previously.
 
• In this context, it introduces the **surprising or contrasting fact that not all swans are white**, following the mention of their distinctive features.
 
• The passage **contrasts **the general expectation of swans being white with the existence of the Black Swan, which is black, making "**However**" the appropriate choice to show this contrast.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**However**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Option (1) **"Consequently"** implies a result or an effect stemming from what has been mentioned before, which does not suit the context of introducing a contrast.
 
• Option (2) **"Because" **introduces a reason or explanation, not a contrasting statement.
 
• Option (3) **"Formerly" **suggests something related to the past, which does not fit the context of contrasting the color of swans.

**Complete Passage is__:** Swans are large waterbirds that ***belong ***to the family Anatidae, which also includes ducks and geese. They ***are known*** for their beauty and grace and are often used as symbols of love, fidelity, and elegance. They are also famous for their ***distinctive ***features, such as their long necks, large wingspans, and striking white feathers. ***However***, not all swan species are white; the Black Swan, ________, has black feathers with a red bill. Swans are found on every continent and are known for their strong pair bonds. They mate for life and can live up to 20 years. Keep the other blank-in-the-blank condition.
